title: ActiveRecord: enum where clause does not work anymore in Rails 6.1 when providing array of strings
body:
### Steps to reproduce
<!-- (Guidelines for creating a bug report are [available
here](https://edgeguides.rubyonrails.org/contributing_to_ruby_on_rails.html#creating-a-bug-report)) -->

When upgrading to Rails 6.1 I encountered a strange bug. In the application, the values to filter by enum property are passed not as an array of integers, but of strings, and that works correctly before. Now, instead of string array passed into `IN` clause, like `enum IN ('0', '1')`, there is `NULL` (`enum IN (NULL)`). I found that [this PR](https://github.com/rails/rails/pull/41068) fixes the issue.

Here is a simplified script to reproduce this error.

```
require "bundler/inline"

gemfile(true) do
  source "https://rubygems.org"
  gem "activerecord", "6.1.2.1"
  # it works using this PR branch
  # gem "rails", github: "ricardotk002/rails", branch: "fix-where-in-stmt-logging"
  gem "sqlite3"
end

require "active_record"
require "minitest/autorun"
require "logger"

ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: "sqlite3", database: ":memory:")
ActiveRecord::Base.logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)

ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
  create_table :users, force: true do |t|
    t.integer :role
    t.string :name
  end
end

class User < ActiveRecord::Base
  enum role: %i[user admin]
end

class BugTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_where_clause
    u1 = User.create(role: :user)
    u2 = User.create(role: :admin)

    users = User.where(role: ["0", "1"])

    assert_includes users, u1
    assert_includes users, u2
  end
end

puts User.where(role: ["0", "1"]).to_sql

```

### Expected behavior

<!-- Tell us what should happen -->

`User.where(role: ["0", "1"]).to_sql` should return `SELECT "users".* FROM "users" WHERE "users"."role" IN ('0', '1')`

### Actual behavior

<!-- Tell us what happens instead -->

`User.where(role: ["0", "1"]).to_sql` returns `SELECT "users".* FROM "users" WHERE "users"."role" IN (NULL)`

### System configuration
**Rails version**:
6.1.2.1
**Ruby version**:
2.7.2
